title: 3. NOT optimal, but working
rule: A real evaluated candidate from the optimiser's own list (results/g10_selection_candidates_r0.csv): N = 80 capsules, flow 0.0227.  Passes every hard gate and beats the plain tank clearly.
why_not_optimal: Falls outside S0 (not within the tie-band of the best g_window): ~23 % less PCM and a slower flow (0.0227 vs 0.0388), so it delivers ~32 % less extra evening heat. Trade-off: far less overheating (shield-hours) - so it is a genuinely working, cheaper design.
